home.tagline: Fit the pieces and make words
home.offline: No internet · the game works offline

pause.title: Paused
pause.howToPlayQuestion: HOW DO YOU WANT TO PLAY?
pause.controlsHint: You can switch at any time. The game remembers your choice.

levelComplete.title: Level {level} complete!
levelComplete.subtitle: You reached the goal of {count} words
levelComplete.bonus: includes a {bonus} bonus for finishing the level
levelComplete.noLinesBonus: and a {bonus} bonus for not completing any line

gameOver.title: Game over
gameOver.subtitle: The pieces reached the top on level {level}

help.wordsText: Like a word search: only the words on the list count, across or down. Longer words are worth more.
help.linesText: A full line disappears like in Tetris and gives extra points. A word and a line together both count.
help.goalText: Find the words on the list to move up a level. Each level brings new letters and words.
help.gesturesAlso: They also work in buttons mode
help.keyboard: On a keyboard: arrows, space to drop and P to pause.

consent.label: Privacy and cookies
consent.text: We use cookies to see how the game is played and to personalize ads. Your scores stay on your device only.

install.title: Install LETRIS
install.text: Open it right from your home screen and play even without internet.
install.iosStep1: Tap the Share button in Safari

rotate.title: Turn your phone
rotate.text: LETRIS is played with the phone upright. The game stays paused until you turn it back.

tutorial.moveButtons: Use the ← and → buttons to move the piece sideways.
tutorial.moveGestures: Swipe sideways on the board to move the piece.
tutorial.rotateButtons: Tap the yellow button to rotate the piece.
tutorial.rotateGestures: Tap the board to rotate the piece.
tutorial.dropButtons: Hold ↓ to move down faster, or tap the red button to drop it.
tutorial.dropGestures: Drag down on the board to make the piece fall faster.
tutorial.word: Move the {letter} next to {start} and drop it to make {word}.
tutorial.line: Now complete the line. A full line disappears and gives points, but the goal is to make the words: lines just free up space on the board.
tutorial.goal: Make {word} to reach the level goal.
tutorial.doneText: Make the words on the list in each level. The pieces get faster as you go.

modes.label: MODE
modes.classicText: Pieces fall. Fit them and make words.
modes.encaixeText: Drag the pieces onto the board and make words.

encaixe.gameOverSubtitle: No piece fits anymore on level {level}
